b0.token_f1_definition: Mean maximum SQuAD token F1 against answerable annotators. An answerable question that the system refuses scores 0. Unanswerable questions are excluded from this mean.
b0.retrieval_definition: Context recall is the fraction of non-empty gold evidence strings covered by any retrieved chunk. Coverage means the normalized evidence is a substring of the chunk, the chunk is a substring of the evidence, or at least 70 percent of evidence tokens of length 4 or more appear in the chunk. Context precision is the fraction of retrieved chunks that cover any gold evidence string. Both are unavailable when the question has no textual evidence. b0 has no retrieved chunks, so its precision is 0 when evidence exists.
b0.model_judge_definition: Among cited sentences sent to the verifier, the fraction labeled SUPPORTED. This is a same-model judgment, not ground truth. MISSING_CHUNK counts as unsupported. Uncited sentences are not in this denominator.
b0.evidence_citation_definition: Among verifier decisions that name a retrieved chunk, the fraction whose chunk covers a gold evidence string. Unavailable when the run has no such decisions or the questions have no evidence.
